name: China General Education Group Limited
summary: China General Education Group Limited (CGEG), established in 2004 and headquartered in Taiyuan, provides private higher education in Shanxi Province and is a subsidiary of Niusanping Limited. Its main institution is Shanxi Technology and Business College, a private undergraduate college offering bachelor's programs in accounting, civil engineering, business administration, computer science and preschool education, plus specialized concentrations such as internet technology and early education.
